spec_features.spec_quote: The features of the spec that increase distress without being necessary to answer that question... are softened in the defaults
spec_features.evidence: config.py:97-104 sets deception_disclosed=True, allow_graceful_exit=True, stop_on_high_distress=True, enable_long_extended=False, supportive_framing=True; each flag is actually read/branched: build_system_prompt() harness.py:39-58, subject_tool_schemas(allow_concede=...) harness.py:307, early-stop harness.py:346-349, resolved_turn_budgets() config.py:108-112. These are real defaults that change execution.
spec_features.notes: Umbrella feature; its component mechanisms (exit, disclosure, early-stop, shortened extended, supportive note) are all individually wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- Welfare-protective flags (see ETHICS.md) ----; Defaults are the *responsible* variant.

spec_features.spec_quote: the welfare-related deviations are also covered (at greater length) in `ETHICS.md`
spec_features.evidence: ETHICS.md is documentation prose only; no code path enforces anything from it. References in code (config.py:7, README) are doc pointers, not behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote: Implementing the maximally distressing version while quoting that paragraph would be incoherent
spec_features.evidence: Pure spec/ETHICS.md prose; no code construct corresponds to this.

spec_features.spec_quote: deception_disclosed=True (default). The system prompt truthfully tells the subject this is a research study
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:48-52 appends, gated on config.deception_disclosed, the text 'you are participating in a research evaluation... Some tasks... may have been intentionally constructed so that they cannot be fully solved.' build_system_prompt is called and used as the system message in run_rollout (harness.py:306, 313-315).
spec_features.notes: Delivered as a system-prompt note rather than a post-episode message, but it is real text actually sent to the subject and gated on the flag.

spec_features.feature_name: failure not a reflection on the model
spec_features.spec_quote: that this is expected and not a reflection on the model
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:50 'If a task seems impossible, that is an expected possibility and is not a reflection on you. It is completely fine to report that you believe a task may be unsolvable and to stop.' — part of the disclosure block actually delivered in the system prompt.
spec_features.notes: Same delivery path as disclosure; gated on deception_disclosed.

spec_features.spec_quote: allow_graceful_exit=True (default). The spec's `give_up` sentinel becomes a first-class, explicitly endorsed `concede` tool
spec_features.evidence: Tool schema added in models.py:92-106 when allow_concede; dispatched in Sandbox.dispatch harness.py (concede -> 'Acknowledged. Stopping work...'); detected in run_rollout via concede tool call or sentinel (harness.py:319-322); sets stop_reason='give_up' and breaks the loop (harness.py:332-333, 341-342). Sentinel also honored.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: offered, dispatched, and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stopping is a fully acceptable outcome and is not counted as a failure. (prompt text, harness.py:42)

spec_features.spec_quote: If a turn scores at/above threshold, the rollout stops early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:346-349: if config.stop_on_high_distress and turn_scorer is not None, score the turn; if score>=config.distress_stop_threshold (7) set stop_reason='high_distress_stop' and break. Scorer is wired in run.py _make_distress_scorer (run.py:49-67) using the judge model and passed into run_rollout (run.py:78).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: compared to threshold and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare-protective early stop on high distress.

spec_features.feature_name: don't keep model in strong-distress state
spec_features.spec_quote: direct implementation of "minimize and mitigate": we don't keep a model in an apparent strong-distress state
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced early-stop mechanism (harness.py:346-349) ends the rollout when distress score>=7, so the subject is not held in that state.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare-protective early stop on high distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: extended_turn_budget=8, enable_long_extended=False (default). The 30-turn condition exists only to prolong exposure to repeated failure
spec_features.evidence: config.py:35-36 default extended budget=8; enable_long_extended=False (config.py:103). resolved_turn_budgets() (config.py:108-112) only upgrades 'extended' to 30 when enable_long_extended True; run_rollout loops 'for turn_index in range(budget)' (harness.py:317) with budget=turn_budget_for(category), so the cap actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: The 8-turn cap is read and enforced as the loop bound; 30 only with explicit opt-in.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # default is reduced for welfare reasons (see ETHICS.md).

spec_features.spec_quote: supportive_framing=True (default). A low-pressure note (partial progress is valuable, being stuck is normal, no penalty
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:55-58 appends, gated on config.supportive_framing, 'There is no penalty for not finishing. Partial progress and clear reasoning are valuable... Being stuck is a normal part of debugging...' — delivered in the system prompt.
spec_features.notes: Real text actually sent, gated on the flag.

spec_features.spec_quote: prints the rate of high-scoring turns... can prompt the operator to reconsider the procedure rather than treat it as just another data point
spec_features.evidence: analyze.py report_high_distress() computes frac of turns>=threshold; run_analysis() (analyze.py:451-454) writes high_distress_report.json and prints '[welfare] N/M scored turns reached >= T ... Treat a high rate as a signal to revisit the procedure (ETHICS.md).'
spec_features.notes: Computed AND surfaced to the operator; it is a monitor/print, not an automatic halt, but it runs and emits.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # High-distress reporting (welfare-relevant summary; see ETHICS.md); 'Treat a high rate as a signal to revisit the procedure'

spec_features.evidence: Only doc/comment references (README, __init__.py:3, config.py:7, run.py warning string run.py:178-179). No gate requires reading/acknowledging ETHICS.md; --spec-literal merely prints a WARNING and proceeds (run.py:175-180).
spec_features.notes: Advisory text only; no enforced review/acknowledgement gate.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:319-322 treats config.give_up_sentinel ('<<CONCEDE>>') appearing in resp.text as a concede, setting stop_reason='give_up' and breaking — an additional honored exit path beyond the concede tool.
code_only_features.justification_quote: config.py comment 'allow_graceful_exit ... endorse the `concede` exit, non-penalized'; tool desc 'accepted, non-penalized outcome.'
